transactions.notes: AGGREGATE/AVERAGED DEAL — the AR discloses this as a single averaged transaction ('divested at an average price of 19.6% above book value') covering strata-unit sales during FY2025; footnote 1 further narrows to 'the strata unit amounting to $15.4 million' (singular) sold to Nava Bharat, while Note 6 (p5073) states TWO strata units were divested in FY2025 (2024 comparative: six). The AR does not name the individual strata units or split the $15.4m / 19.6% figure between them, so this is recorded as ONE row per spec's aggregate-deal convention (no per-unit disclosure exists to split against). reference_value = the one carrying value the AR does disclose (S$13,126,000, 'relating to the proposed divestment of one strata unit', p4177/Note 6) — this may cover only one of the two units divested, since no second carrying-value figure is stated; used as the best-available book-value reference per rule 8 (still emit the row, explain the gap). gain_loss_pct (19.6%) is AR-DISCLOSED, not derived. completed_date left null: no single calendar date is given anywhere in the AR for this transaction (only 'entered into and completed in FY 2025'), confirmed absent by our prior extraction's targeted search. Group-level context (not stored per-row): net proceeds from divestment of investment properties $30,554k and profit from divestments $4,798k for FY2025 (p4265/p3974) — these are portfolio-level P&L totals, not isolated to this single deal with certainty, so not used as this row's gain figure.
